overview: BB-8 is a astromech droid built by Industrial Automaton, documented across Sequel Trilogy · Resistance. A spherical orange-and-white astromech whose loyalty to Poe Dameron and the Resistance made it an icon of the Sequel Era, rolling through Starkiller Base, Crait, and Exegol with relentless optimism.
